calls.title: GrowthBook Onboarding Kickoff
calls.summary: The customer is transitioning feature flags from Dev Cycle to Growth Book, with six to eight teams involved. The migration requires custom scripts since no ready-made tool exists. Murray Writtle will lead configuration efforts, while enablement sessions are planned to assist developers and architects with setup and flag integration. The initial priority is getting feature flags operational before moving on to experimentation, which will add data warehouse integration later. Additionally, there are challenges with account setup and security configurations, including the need for Azure SSO and SCIM support. A shared Slack channel for real-time communication has been proposed to facilitate support during this transition.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, feature flags, Open Feature, enablement session, Dev Cycle migration, SSO integration
